## What's new

- **Update notices.** From this version on, RayLink tells you when a new version is out, shows what changed, and downloads and installs it with one tap. On macOS you still drag it to Applications yourself.
- **Accurate Real Delay while connected.** Testing servers with the VPN on no longer goes through the VPN, so the results match a test with it off, including for servers added by name instead of an IP address. TCP ping has the same fix.
